verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS accounting platform, but the evidence pack shows no Zoho Books command-line tool. It documents a REST API, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, OAuth, the hosted Zoho MCP service and mobile/desktop apps. These are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an official CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
